brief: Anselm, who was born in 1033 and died in 1109, is remembered primarily as a teacher of the faith. His treatises on the existence of God and the doctrines of the incarnation and the atonement gained him a reputation as an outstanding theologian and philosopher. As Archbishop of Canterbury he initiated significant reforms in church organisation. He is also remembered for his insistence on the spiritual authority of the church over against the crown.
